name: md-fqn-stability
body: The set of NON-ROOT `md.*` module FQNs and `md.<file>.<heading-path>` heading Struct FQNs produced by a post-change scan must be identical to the pre-change set; no non-root Markdown FQN may be renamed, moved under a new language root, or dropped. The repo-root module is the one deliberate exception: the pre-change root module name `md.apg` is the checkout-directory basename, so it violates `requirements.constraint.no-checkout-named-module` and must render repo-relative as `md.` (SPEC.md §4.3's `<repo-relative-dir>` rule). The non-root dir modules (`md.opencode-suite/agents`, `md.plans`) and all heading Structs (`md.AGENTS.md.*`, `md.README.md.*`, `md.opencode-suite/agents/*.md.*`, which are file-rooted and do not embed the module identity) are unchanged.
